characters.name: Alizebeth "Beta" Bequin
characters.title: Pariah, narrator and Inquisitorial agent
characters.fate: Ends Penitent having entered the City of Dust through a Maze Undue mirror and escaped using Enuncia. Her allies then learn the King in Yellow's name begins 'Constantin Valdor'.
characters.origin: Queen Mab, Sancour (Scholam Orbus orphanage); grown from Alizebeth Bequin's genetic material
characters.summary: First-person narrator of the series. She was raised in the Scholam Orbus and trained at the Maze Undue, which she believed was an Inquisition school for blanks but was really run by the Cognitae. After Ravenor's raid destroys the Maze, at least seven factions hunt her. She learns she is a modified clone ('daughter, technically') of Eisenhorn's acolyte Alizebeth Bequin and joins Eisenhorn. In Penitent she works for Ravenor after Eisenhorn's apparent death and is given a rosette.
characters.wargear: Limiter cuff that dials her pariah aura up or down; small silver blades; a blinkblade in Penitent
characters.epithet: The cuckoo the Cognitae raised badly

relationships.note: joins his hunt; he treats her as a surrogate daughter
his prisoner in Pariah, then his agent in Penitent
closest friend; seeks him out after his mind-wipe
knew her as Sister Bismillah; later disillusioned
dropped her off a roof; later her partner

characters.name: Alizebeth Bequin
characters.title: Eisenhorn's original blank acolyte (deceased)
characters.fate: Died long before the series. Her stasis-held body went missing in 461.M41, and the Cognitae used her genetic material to create Beta.
characters.summary: The Eisenhorn-era acolyte and blank whom Eisenhorn loved but could never touch. She led his Distaff organisation of blanks and fell into a coma after turning her aura against the Chaos Titan Cruor Vult. She does not appear on the page in Pariah or Penitent. Her legacy drives the plot: Beta was grown from her genome, and Eisenhorn and Ravenor both react to Beta through her memory. She is a separate person from Beta.
characters.epithet: The original whose ghost wears Beta's face

relationships.note: he kept her body in stasis

characters.name: Gregor Eisenhorn
characters.title: Rogue Inquisitor hunting the King in Yellow
characters.fate: Faked his death when his hideout was attacked in Penitent, which pushed Beta toward Ravenor. He then reappears and reaches an uneasy truce with Ravenor.
characters.summary: Ancient, augmented and declared a heretic by the Ordos. He has spent about twenty years on Sancour watching Beta through his agents, hoping to use her to reach the King in Yellow. He rescues her from the Emperor's Children and recruits her. Cherubael frees her from Ravenor at his order. He now commands Cherubael absolutely.
characters.wargear: Psychically attuned sword; command of the daemonhost Cherubael
characters.epithet: An old wolf playing the longest game

relationships.note: former pupil turned hunter, then uneasy ally
lost love; Beta reminds him of her

characters.name: Gideon Ravenor
characters.title: Inquisitor, Ordo Hereticus
characters.fate: Asked the Aeldari for help, and they resolved to destroy the subsector; he bought only one week of grace. He ends Penitent in a tense truce with Eisenhorn.
characters.summary: Eisenhorn's former interrogator, now encased in a force chair. Reinstated by the Inquisition to hunt Eisenhorn, he led the raid that destroyed the Maze Undue. He used Renner Lightburn to lure Beta and then imprisoned her. In Penitent he takes Beta on as an agent and holds a séance with the dead Timurlin. His Aeldari dealings break Patience Kys's trust in him.
characters.epithet: A mind in a box, hardened by a century

relationships.note: former mentor he was sent to sanction
imprisons her, later gives her a rosette
his interrogator, killed at the Maze
used him as an unwitting pawn, then mind-wiped him
pressed the amnesiac weapons-master into service

characters.name: Renner Lightburn
characters.title: Curst penitent and bodyguard
characters.fate: His memory was wiped by Ravenor's people after Pariah. Beta finds him again in Penitent, and at the end he is guarding Freddy Dance and reports the King's name.
characters.summary: A Curst: a penitent sentenced by the Ecclesiarchy to lifelong service. Every burden he takes on is inked on his skin, and his tattoos cover most of his body. His original crime was sheltering a hunted girl while a cathedral guard; she turned out to be an unsanctioned psyker. Ravenor's agents, posing as Mam Mordaunt, sent him to bring Beta in. He shot Eisenhorn during the basilica fight without knowing who he was.
characters.wargear: Firearms; a body covered in tattooed burdens
characters.epithet: A man written over with others' sins

relationships.note: took his burden from her while she posed as Mordaunt
guards him while he decodes the book
met him with Beta in the Below

characters.name: Medea Betancore
characters.title: Eisenhorn's pilot and deep-cover agent
characters.fate: Took part in Eisenhorn's faked death in Penitent. Beta decides she is no mother figure after all.
characters.summary: She faked her own death to rejoin Eisenhorn. For about twenty years she posed as Sister Bismillah at the Scholam Orbus, watching over Beta, and she is the closest thing Beta has to a mother. She helps rescue Beta from Teke and the Word Bearers. In Penitent she found the astronomy treatise that led to Freddy Dance.
characters.epithet: The nun who was never a nun

characters.name: Harlon Nayl
characters.title: Veteran bounty hunter
characters.fate: Survives the attack on Eisenhorn's hideout and brokers Beta's contact with Ravenor. He ends Penitent among the reunited bands.
characters.summary: An aging but still formidable fighter in Eisenhorn's last band. He switches sides between Eisenhorn and Ravenor more than once, which frustrates Patience Kys. He saves Beta from a Blackwards mercenary in Pariah.
characters.epithet: A hard man between two masters

characters.name: Cherubael
characters.title: Daemonhost
characters.fate: Last seen sent by Eisenhorn to retrieve Beta, and set upon by Comus Nocturnus.
characters.summary: Eisenhorn's daemonhost, completely docile under his control (credited to Eisenhorn's Enuncia experiences in The Magos). He snatches Beta from Ravenor's custody at the end of Pariah. In Penitent he admits a twisted fondness for her while gleefully threatening her and Patience.
characters.epithet: A smiling horror on a short leash

relationships.note: rescuer and tormentor; fond of her

characters.name: Deathrow
characters.title: Holloway watchman, secretly Alpha Legion
characters.fate: Defeats Teke while protecting Beta and reveals 'I am Alpharius'. His later role is unrevealed.
characters.summary: A masked, gene-altered veteran who patrols Queen Mab's holloways with his hound. He has secretly watched over Beta for years. He is one of Eisenhorn's specialists and an Alpha Legionnaire: he runs Teke through, and Teke glimpses the truth behind his mask.
characters.epithet: The watchman with a Legion's secret

characters.name: Patience Kys
characters.title: Telekine agent of Ravenor
characters.fate: Fed up with Ravenor's Aeldari dealings, she walks out with Beta and anchors her trip into the City of Dust.
characters.summary: In Pariah she infiltrates the Maze Undue and is knocked off a roof by Beta, surviving only because Ravenor caught her telekinetically. She impersonates Mam Mordaunt to trap Beta. In Penitent she becomes Beta's partner and openly equates Ravenor's ruthlessness with Eisenhorn's.
characters.epithet: A blade-dancer losing faith

relationships.note: gave him the burden of fetching Beta

characters.name: Kara Swole
characters.title: Agent of Ravenor
characters.fate: Still serving Ravenor at the end of Penitent.
characters.summary: A former acrobat, still loyal to Ravenor and resentful of Eisenhorn's heresy. In Pariah she tells Beta that Eisenhorn harnesses daemons, which Beta disbelieves. In Penitent she helps Ravenor and Beta interrogate Timurlin's spirit.
characters.epithet: Ravenor's steady hand

characters.name: Darra Voriet
characters.title: Interrogator, Ordo Hereticus
characters.fate: Killed infiltrating the Maze Undue after weapons-master Saur, rescued by Beta, overcame him. His death prompted Ravenor's raid.
characters.summary: An Inquisition operative earlier attached to Eisenhorn, who suspected he was a plant. In Pariah he is Ravenor's agent. He breaks into the Maze Undue and dies naming the Cognitae, the first hint of the school's true masters.
characters.epithet: The spy whose death lit the fuse

relationships.note: spied on him for the Inquisition

characters.name: Judika Sowl
characters.title: Maze Undue graduate and grael host
characters.fate: Killed by Teke, who recognised him as one of the Eight. A seeming clone of him later confronts Beta in the City of Dust.
characters.summary: A blank who graduated from the Maze a few years ahead of Beta and was said to have become an interrogator. Beta once had a crush on him. He flees the raid with her but is snide, and his health fails. He had ingested an 'Eight' and was host to the grael Magent, which attacked the cathedral during Beta's Enuncia ordeal.
characters.epithet: The boy with a spider inside

relationships.note: host of one of the Eight

characters.name: Faria
characters.title: Maze Undue classmate
characters.fate: A seeming clone of her is among the pariahs who confront Beta in the City of Dust.
characters.summary: One of Beta's fellow trainees at the Maze Undue and a better shot than her. In Penitent, Beta meets apparent copies of Faria and Judika serving the King in Yellow inside the City of Dust.
characters.epithet: A familiar face in the wrong city

characters.name: Thaddeus Saur
characters.title: Weapons-master of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: His conditioning by the King's agents made him lead the graels to Mam Mordaunt. He was then killed, apparently by Mordaunt at his own request.
characters.summary: Beta's combat instructor, whom she saved from Voriet. He signalled the dispersal during Ravenor's raid. Ravenor later took him on as an apparent amnesiac. In Penitent he joins Beta and Lightburn to infiltrate Mordaunt's tower, where his hidden conditioning betrays them.
characters.epithet: A sword-master turned beacon

characters.name: Mam Mordaunt
characters.title: Senior Cognitae mentor of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: Called on the Immaterial College when hundreds of graels attacked her hideout, then vanished in the chaos.
characters.summary: In Pariah she is mostly off-stage: Patience Kys impersonates her to lure Beta. In Penitent she is one of the last Cognitae leaders. The King in Yellow has turned on the Cognitae, and she hides in a tower full of spying 'secret mirrors', seeking protection from Eisenhorn and then the Immaterial College.
characters.wargear: Secret mirrors; weapons usable against graels
characters.epithet: Last mistress of a betrayed school

characters.name: Ebon Nastrand
characters.title: The Secretary of the Maze Undue
characters.fate: His fate after Ravenor's raid is unknown.
characters.summary: Head of the Maze Undue for over a century. He reacted strangely when Beta suggested the Cognitae were behind events, which foreshadows that he and all the staff were Cognitae.
characters.epithet: The quiet hand behind the Maze

characters.name: Balthus Blackwards
characters.title: Patriarch of the Blackwards merchant house
characters.fate: His deal with the Ministorum and the Word Bearers collapsed with the cathedral, ruining his house's gamble.
characters.summary: Head of the Blackwards dynasty, which deals in heretical artefacts for the Glaws, the Cognitae and even the King in Yellow. Beta was investigating his emporium undercover. After the Maze fell he abducted her and sold her to the Ecclesiarchy's Enuncia project.
characters.wargear: Animated, poison-bladed dolls of the Blackwards Emporium
characters.epithet: A merchant who sold the wrong girl

characters.name: Lupan
characters.title: Shopkeeper of the Blackwards Emporium
characters.fate: Not recorded in available sources.
characters.summary: Runs the Blackwards emporium Beta infiltrates as 'Laurael Raeside'. Among the books he sets out for her is one of Lilean Chase's journals, the cipher text that drives Penitent.
characters.epithet: Dealer in dangerous curios

characters.name: Pontifex Urba
characters.title: Senile Pontifex of Queen Mab
characters.fate: His subordinates' Enuncia conspiracy ended when the cathedral fell.
characters.summary: An aged head of the local Ecclesiarchy whose mind is eroding and whom his clergy sideline. During Beta's interrogation he has a vision and gives her a cryptic warning for Eisenhorn. Most of what he says is nonsense, but some of it is true.
characters.epithet: A mad priest speaking true by accident

relationships.note: his church allied with the Word Bearers

characters.name: Scarpac
characters.title: Word Bearers champion
characters.fate: Pursuing Beta, he clashed with Teke and was apparently destroyed.
characters.summary: Leader of the Word Bearers allied with Queen Mab's Ministorum and the Blackwards. He sought a pariah to speak Enuncia against the King in Yellow, and forced Beta to read words of power until an altar shattered.
characters.epithet: A dark apostle's hunter of words

characters.name: Constant Shadrake
characters.title: Warp-touched painter
characters.fate: Killed during the confrontation at Alace Quatorze's villa.
characters.summary: A painter who works through a viewing glass that shows reality shaped by the Immaterium. Beta once investigated him while posing as the model Padua Prate. After the cathedral he shelters her and takes her to his patron, Alace Quatorze, who had been using him.
characters.epithet: He painted what the glass saw

characters.name: Alace Quatorze
characters.title: Last scion of House Glaw
characters.fate: Her pact with the Emperor's Children collapsed when she failed to open the way to the City of Dust.
characters.summary: Mistress of the Villa Feverfugue and patron of Shadrake. She is secretly a Glaw, of the heretic dynasty Eisenhorn fought, and is seeking the entrance to the City of Dust for her ally Teke. She hands Beta and Judika over to him.
characters.epithet: An old heresy's last daughter

characters.name: Teke
characters.title: Emperor's Children sorcerer
characters.fate: Run through by Deathrow and forced into an undignified retreat; later fate unknown.
characters.summary: A cultured Chaos Space Marine of the Emperor's Children, sent (reportedly at Fulgrim's command) to find the way into the City of Dust. He kills Judika, savages Scarpac's Word Bearers and attacks Beta and Lightburn. He wields sorcerous rose petals that swarm or form armour.
characters.wargear: Sorcerous rose petals forming a swarm or power armour
characters.epithet: Petals, poison and a permanent grin

characters.name: The King in Yellow
characters.title: Hidden master of the City of Dust
characters.fate: Unbeaten. Penitent ends with his name, decoded from Lilean Chase's book, beginning 'Constantin Valdor'.
characters.origin: City of Dust (extimate space linked to Queen Mab)
characters.summary: A legendary figure served by the Eight (graels), who never appears on the page. He used the Cognitae for pariahs and lore, then purged them. He commands winged 'angels', 'custodians' and cloned blanks, and is thought to seek the Emperor's true name through Enuncia. Chaos legions, the Immaterial College, both Inquisitors and five Aeldari craftworlds all oppose him.
characters.wargear: Graels; armies of winged angels and custodians
characters.epithet: A crown of dust behind every mask

relationships.note: host of one of his Eight

characters.name: Lilean Chase
characters.title: Founder of the Cognitae
characters.fate: Long dead; her ciphered commonplace book yields the King in Yellow's name.
characters.summary: The ancient founder of the Cognitae, present only through her writings. Beta obtains one of her journals in Pariah, encoded and showing only the number 119. Freddy Dance decodes it in Penitent.
characters.epithet: A dead woman's cipher names a king

characters.name: Comus Nocturnus
characters.title: Winged Blood Angel
characters.fate: Last seen fighting Cherubael at Beta's command.
characters.origin: City of Dust (escaped via the Below)
characters.summary: An amnesiac Blood Angel with real wings like Sanguinius, apparently a creation of the King in Yellow. He bursts out of the Below in the grip of the Red Thirst, which Beta's aura calms. He swears to her and comes whenever her blood is spilled. Unarmoured and naked, he kills an armoured Night Lord barehanded.
characters.epithet: An angel answering to blood

characters.name: Freddy Dance
characters.title: Mad astronomer and mathematician
characters.fate: Decodes Lilean Chase's book under Lightburn's guard, revealing 'Constantin Valdor'.
characters.summary: A disgraced, blind astronomer whose star charts match no sky over Queen Mab, because he had seen the stars of the City of Dust. Eisenhorn and Beta seek him as a way in. Beta realises he is not truly mad. He theorises about Enuncia as numbers and suspects the King is a Lost Primarch.
characters.epithet: He read the wrong sky

characters.name: Connort Timurlin
characters.title: Cognitae perfecti assassin
characters.fate: Killed attacking Beta's group. Ravenor's séance with his spirit accidentally summoned the Immaterial College.
characters.summary: One of the few remaining Cognitae perfecti, bodyguard to Mam Mordaunt. He was sent to negotiate with Eisenhorn and keeps a 'blinkblade' in a pocket dimension. Interrogated after death, he reveals the King's purge of the Cognitae.
characters.epithet: A blade in the blink of an eye

characters.name: Waltur Aulay
characters.title: Ordo Malleus Inquisitor gone native
characters.fate: Revealed as an Inquisitor late in Penitent; seemingly set up for the next book.
characters.summary: Sent to infiltrate Sancour's aristocracy in search of a heretic. He took a cover identity as an engraver and so enjoyed it, and drink, that he lost contact with his ordo and became the drunk he pretended to be, one of Crookley's set.
characters.epithet: The mask that swallowed the man

characters.name: Crookley
characters.title: Poet and occult salon host
characters.fate: Not recorded in available sources.
characters.summary: A drink-loving rebel poet whose circles trade forbidden ideas among Queen Mab's elite. Eisenhorn and Beta move through his scene undercover while hunting Freddy Dance.
characters.epithet: Toasting heresy by candlelight

characters.name: Senefuru of Tizca
characters.title: Leader of the Immaterial College
characters.fate: Fought the graels at Mordaunt's hideout; outcome unknown.
characters.summary: A Thousand Sons sorcerer who binds the squabbling Immaterial College together. The College is a cabal of traitor and loyalist Astartes formed after Isstvan to fight 'the Tyrant'. Speaking the College's name summons it, as Ravenor learns.
characters.epithet: A sorcerer chaining legions together

characters.name: Sadoth Xarbia
characters.title: Night Lord of the Immaterial College
characters.fate: Pursued Beta and was stopped by her grael-weapons and Comus. The TV Tropes page says Comus killed a Night Lord barehanded.
characters.summary: A Night Lords sorcerer with psychic bat-wings who fights with lightning claws and bolter. Most of what is known of the College comes from his boasting, which earns a blow from a fellow member. He chases Beta after the grael battle.
characters.epithet: A night-winged braggart

locations.name: Sancour
locations.note: Decaying Imperial world in the Angelus Subsector of the Scarus Sector, and the setting of both novels.

locations.name: Queen Mab
locations.note: Faded hive city in Sancour's southern hemisphere (Hercula prefecture), with a Victorian, French-tinged air, abandoned shipyards and saint-hallowed streets.

locations.name: The Maze Undue
locations.note: Cognitae-run training school for blanks posing as an Inquisition academy (name corrupted from 'maison dieu'); razed by Ravenor, its secret mirrors later let Beta into the City of Dust.

locations.name: Scholam Orbus
locations.note: Orphanage beside the Maze Undue where Beta was raised, watched by Medea as Sister Bismillah.

locations.name: The City of Dust
locations.note: The King in Yellow's vast extimate realm: a palace-city on an island in a tamed sea of warp, under a sky holding the Eye of Terror.

locations.name: The Below
locations.note: Abandoned buried strata and ossuaries beneath Queen Mab, home to mad anatomists, where Beta finds Renner and meets Comus.

locations.name: The Holloways
locations.note: Forbidden passages of Queen Mab patrolled by drug-burned veteran watchmen like Deathrow, which Beta uses to move unseen.

locations.name: Cathedral of Queen Mab
locations.note: Pilgrimage cathedral where the Ministorum and Word Bearers forced Beta to speak Enuncia, until it began to collapse.

locations.name: Villa Feverfugue
locations.note: Alace Quatorze's mansion, sought as a possible gateway to the City of Dust, where Teke kills Judika.

locations.name: Blackwards Emporium
locations.note: Antique shop of the Blackwards dynasty, guarded by animated poison-bladed dolls, where Beta found Lilean Chase's journal.

books.title: Pariah
books.summary: In Queen Mab on Sancour, the blank Beta Bequin is nearly a graduate of the Maze Undue when a raid destroys the school and scatters her into hiding. Pursued by the Blackwards house, the Ministorum and its Word Bearer allies, the Emperor's Children sorcerer Teke and the grael-host Judika, she is helped by the Curst Renner Lightburn and the mysterious Deathrow. Eisenhorn's people reveal that the Maze was a Cognitae front, that the raid was Ravenor's, and that she is a clone of Alizebeth Bequin. A trap delivers her to Ravenor, and Cherubael snatches her from his cell at Eisenhorn's order.

books.title: Penitent
books.summary: Months later, Beta works with Eisenhorn to find a way into the King in Yellow's City of Dust, chasing the blind astronomer Freddy Dance to decode Lilean Chase's ciphered book. She recovers the mind-wiped Lightburn and gains the winged Blood Angel Comus. Eisenhorn apparently dies when his base burns, so she joins Ravenor, uncovers the King's purge of the Cognitae and witnesses the Immaterial College fight hundreds of graels. Ravenor's Aeldari contacts give Sancour one week before five craftworlds strike, and Eisenhorn turns out to be alive. Beta enters the City of Dust through a mirror and escapes, and Dance decodes the King's name: Constantin Valdor.
